title: Cinnamomum camphora essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Cinnamomum camphora essential oil is a potent aromatic extract derived from the leaves of the Cinnamomum camphora tree, commonly known as the camphor laurel. This oil is widely used in herbalism for its stimulating, antiseptic, and analgesic properties. It is often applied topically to relieve muscle pain, reduce inflammation, and treat respiratory conditions such as congestion. In aromatherapy, it is used to invigorate the mind and improve circulation. Its versatility makes it a valuable ingredient in both traditional and modern herbal medicine.
